announcement.permission.announcements_se: Compose, schedule, send, test, retry and withdraw announcements and edit maintenance notices. In the root tenant it reaches every tenant (behind the platform admin gate); elsewhere the workspace's own members. High impact: a send can mail every user.
announcement.permission.announcements_vi: See the announcements meant for oneself in the shell (popup, banner, toast) and acknowledge them.
